title: External readiness attestations
note: These gates are intentionally outside the local 100-point engineering rubric. A repository cannot award itself production, adoption, regulatory, or third-party integration evidence. Each gate remains required until evidence tied to the exact release commit is independently verified.

gates.title: Hosted CI passes on the exact release commit
gates.owner_action: Push the reviewed commit and record the completed hosted CI run for that exact SHA.

gates.title: Live model providers pass approved smoke and policy tests
gates.owner_action: Run consented live probes through configured OmniRoute or OpenRouter credentials without storing the credentials.

gates.title: Representative adapters pass approved vendor sandboxes
evidence_required: one approved sandbox per claimed integration class
gates.owner_action: Authorize sandbox accounts and run the adapter conformance suite against them.

gates.title: A non-maintainer completes the new-user and recovery journeys
gates.owner_action: Observe at least one consented non-maintainer completing the golden path and recovery path.

gates.title: Independent team review accepts the release candidate
gates.owner_action: Obtain review from a person who did not implement the release.

gates.title: Applicable regulated deployment receives accountable approval
gates.owner_action: When the OS is used for a regulated decision, obtain organization-specific legal, compliance, and risk approval.

gates.title: Release artifact, tag, and provenance are published consistently
gates.owner_action: Create the authorized release tag and publish artifacts only after all applicable gates are verified.
